messages:
kevin: derby alert! City vs Rivals Sunday 4pm. thinking of a rooftop watch with thermos hot chocolate and the office flag. who's free? :flag-white:

tara: rooftop sounds peak dramatic. i will bring hot chocolate and my questionable referee whistle.

isabel: i can make a banner. also quick poll: silent roof or singing encouraged?

omar: singing very encouraged. we have to chant like it's 2006. :microphone:

sid: i vote for a neutral ambient playlist until goals happen, then full chaos. also i'll bring the spare extension cord.

watchbot: live stream link: https://stream.example/derby (rooftop access: badge + escort; weather: chance of drizzle)

kevin: note on logistics: rooftop capacity ~12. RSVP now. we're also taking a tiny $3 pool for final score. winner gets a mystery pastry from the bakery downstairs.

tara: pastry stakes accepted. bet: 2-1 City.

isabel: 1-1 draw for me. and i'll make a small raffle for whoever guesses the minute of first yellow card.

omar: submitting 23' yellow prediction. lowball but iconic.

sid: 45+1' for me. last minute drama energy.

kevin: RSVP list so far: kevin, tara, isabel, omar, sid. if you're bringing friends, tell security in advance.

tara: also side-game: tiny fantasy sub-pool for the matchday performance. highest fantasy points gets a sticker and temporary desk crown.

isabel: crown is a must. omar you're on trophy engraving duty if you lose.

omar: i accept the challenge. i will also bring celebratory confetti in eco-friendly paper only.

watchbot: weather update at 2pm will auto-post. reminder: rooftop closed after 6pm per building rules.

kevin: final quick: if it pours, backup meeting room E is booked. i'll post final confirmation by 3:30.

tara: i'm also down for a halftime meme exchange. bring your best goalkeeper memes.

isabel: putting together a 3-slide halftime slideshow. please DM me memes or gifs.

sid: will the pastry winner be allowed to share? i can host a tiny pastry-sampling table for safe portion control.

isabel: yes shareables only. no crumbs left on laptops.

kevin: perfect. see rooftop 3:45pm for warmup chants and last-minute bets. may the best chant—and pastry—win. :soccer_ball:
